texts.preamble: Sri Suresh Binani vs Commissioner Cum Disignated Officer on 26 December, 2017 Author: Aravind Kumar Bench: Aravind Kumar 1 In The High Court Of Karnataka At Bengaluru Dated This The 26Th Day Of December 2017 Before The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Aravind Kumar Writ Petition No.58284 Of 2017 (Lb-Bmp) Between: Sri Suresh Binani S/O Sri.N.B.Binani Aged About 49 Years Proprietor Of Swadesh Fine Dine Restaurant No.57, 36Th Cross Jayanagar 4Th 'T' Block Jayanagar Bengaluru - 560 011 ... Petitioner (By Sri.Muralidhar H.M, Adv.) And: 1. Commissioner Cum Designated Officer Under The Food Safety & Standards Act 2006 Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike N.R.Square, Hudson Circle Bengaluru - 560 002 2. The Health Officer Cum Designated Officer Of The Area Under The Food Safety & Standards Act 2006 Bbmp (South), Jayanagar Zone First Floor, Jayanagar Shopping Complex 4Th Block, Jayanagar Bengaluru - 560 011 ... Respondents 2 Sri Suresh Binani vs Commissioner Cum Disignated Officer on 26 December, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91535118/ 1 This Writ Petition is filed under Articles 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India, praying to call for the records on the file of the respondents peruse the same allow the writ petition, quash the notice dated 13.11.2017 vide Annexure-A issued by respondent No.2, and etc. This Petition coming on for Preliminary Hearing this day, the Court made the following:- Order
texts.facts: Since allegation of petitioner that officials of 2nd respondent office are visiting the business premises is only a self serving statement and not supported by any complaint lodged by petitioner to higher authorities in that regard, same cannot be entertained.
texts.arguments: Heard Sri.H.M.Muralidhar, learned counsel appearing for petitioner and perused the records. 2. Petitioner is said to be carrying on hotel business under name and style "Swadesh Fine and Dine Restaurant" at 4th 'T' Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru. It is contended that after obtaining trade license and the license as required under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, said business is being carried on without violating any of the conditions imposed under these licenses and in this factual background, impugned notice dated 13.11.2017 has now been issued by 2nd respondent to show cause as to why license should not be cancelled. It is further contended that despite petitioner having replied to the said notice on 20.11.2017 - Annexure-D, respondents are not allowing the petitioner to carry on the business peacefully and are visiting the business premises quite often and threatening the petitioner that business would be closed down.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Heard Sri.H.M.Muralidhar, learned counsel appearing for petitioner and perused the records. 2. Petitioner is said to be carrying on hotel business under name and style "Swadesh Fine and Dine Restaurant" at 4th 'T' Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru. It is contended that after obtaining trade license and the license as required under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, said business is being carried on without violating any of the conditions imposed under these licenses and in this factual background, impugned notice dated 13.11.2017 has now been issued by 2nd respondent to show cause as to why license should not be cancelled. It is further contended that despite petitioner having replied to the said notice on 20.11.2017 - Annexure-D, respondents are not allowing the petitioner to carry on the business peacefully and are visiting the business premises quite often and threatening the petitioner that business would be closed down.
